svg.text: C · immutable task and trusted evidence contracts
Agent output, host authorization, verified evidence, safety and stop acknowledgment are separate types.
id / run_id / cycle / step: str / attempt
StopRequest is an input to Infrastructure.request_stop; StopDelivery only acknowledges delivery. Inspection is the redacted Runtime view. AgentResult.output is a frozen mapping (outcome,
deliverable, evidence, operations, checkpoint, wait, blocker), not another class.
